title: Xolotrain
tagline: An onchain virtual axolotl pet that lives, evolves, and travels across networks
description: Xolotrain is a blockchain-based Tamagotchi-style game where players nurture digital axolotl pets whose health is directly tied to the performance of their Uniswap v4 liquidity positions. Players earn rewards through active LP management while their pet companions react to and visualize their DeFi activity.
how_its_made: Built with Solidity + Foundry on a mainnet-fork (Anvil) to deploy and test real Uniswap v4 (PoolManager/PositionManager) LP flows. The game UI is Next.js/React (Scaffold-ETH 2) with Wagmi/Viem. A Node.js/TypeScript agent monitors LP ticks to update pet health onchain and drives intent-based cross-chain travel via The Compact + Li.Fi.
